text: Lunch with Simone. She's gone fully vegan since the summer and says she's never felt better. Oat milk only, and she can't stand mushrooms.
Graham's dad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is at St Mary's on 2 November 2026. Remind me to send a card to Graham and his mum before then.

spans.text: send a card to Graham and his mum

text: Spoke to Duc on the phone. He was made redundant on Friday after nine years at the bank. He's putting a brave face on it but he sounded flat, and he said his wife is more worried than he is because of the mortgage. He's been told he'll get three months' pay. I should check in with him sometime next week, and maybe send him that recruiter's details.
Karan is allergic to peanuts and tree nuts, properly allergic, he carries an EpiPen. Worth remembering for the barbecue.

spans.text: allergic to peanuts and tree nuts

text: Zoe and Louis have split up. She told me over coffee this morning. They were meant to be getting married in March 2027, but that's all off now. She's staying with her sister Ebony for a while.
Nikhil doesn't drink at all, but he loves a really good ginger beer. Fentimans if we can find it.
Phoebe's grandmother died last week. The funeral is sometime early next month in Cork, and Phoebe is flying over with her brother Thomas. Don't forget to ask her when exactly so I can send flowers.
Need to pick up the dry cleaning and book the car in for its MOT before the end of the month.

spans.text: book the car in for its MOT
before the end of the month

text: Had dinner at Elena and Kemal's. Kemal cooked an amazing lamb tagine. Elena is pescatarian, so she had the fish version. Their daughter Matilda starts secondary school in September.
Rebecca rang. Her company is doing another round of redundancies and she finds out on 14 November 2026 whether her role is affected. She's really anxious about it. Remind me to text her that morning.
Sinead is coeliac. Proper coeliac, not just avoiding bread. Cross contamination matters, so separate toaster and everything.
Jin mentioned that his mum has been unwell again. She's back in hospital for more tests early next week. He's trying to juggle it with work and looks exhausted.
Aaliyah's cat Biscuit had to be put to sleep yesterday. She was in bits at work. I should get her something small, maybe a plant.
Bogdan and Zara are hosting a housewarming at the end of the month. Zara said not to bring wine because Bogdan has given up alcohol for the year. Bring sparkling elderflower instead.

Aarav told me his parents are visiting from Pune over the summer. His dad is diabetic and his mum is strictly vegetarian, no eggs either. He wants to take them somewhere nice for dinner and asked if I had ideas.
Tamar loves really dark chocolate, the 85 percent stuff. She hates anything with coconut in it.

spans.text: hates anything with coconut in it

text: Called Jasmine. Her uncle's funeral was on Thursday and it sounds like it was hard, especially for her mum, who was his younger sister. Jasmine said she's okay, but she isn't sleeping much. Must call her again at the weekend.
Haruto has started a keto diet. No rice, no bread, lots of eggs. He's been doing it since early September and swears by it.

Mei and Thabo are expecting their first baby in April 2027. Mei can't eat soft cheese or sushi at the moment, which she says is killing her. Thabo is already panicking about the nursery, and his mum keeps sending him links to cots. Her scan is on 12 November 2026, and they're telling their families properly after that. Mei said she mostly craves salt and vinegar crisps and cold orange juice.

spans.text: can't eat soft cheese or sushi
mostly craves salt and vinegar crisps and cold orange juice

text: Aiko's last day at the agency is 28 November 2026. She wasn't made redundant; she took voluntary redundancy and is going travelling in the new year. Remind me to organise a leaving card with the others.

spans.text: organise a leaving card with the others

text: Angela said her brother Felix is getting divorced. His wife moved out a couple of weeks ago. Angela is worried about him because he's not eating properly and won't talk about it. Their parents don't know yet, and he wants to tell them himself when he visits at the end of the month. She asked if I'd keep an eye on him at five a side.
Note to self: Milan prefers tea to coffee, builder's tea, milk and two sugars.

spans.text: builder's tea, milk and two sugars

text: Divya's band has a gig on 6 December 2026 at the Lexington. She's playing keyboard and is nervous because it's their first headline show. Don't forget to text her good luck on the day.
Graham said the wake will be at the Red Lion after the service. His sister Sinead is organising the food and asked if anyone knows of guests with allergies.
Ebony broke up with her boyfriend over the weekend. She said it had been coming for a while and she actually feels relieved. We're going for drinks sometime next week.
Duc's interview with the council is on Tuesday. It's the first one since the redundancy and he's really nervous. Remind me to ask Duc how it went on Wednesday.
Booked flights to Lisbon for early March. I still need to sort the hotel and travel insurance.

spans.text: sort the hotel and travel insurance

text: Bumped into Mrs Nowak at the shops. Her husband had his hip replaced last month and he's recovering slowly. She said he's fed up of being stuck indoors.
Kemal mentioned that his mum isn't eating much since his dad died in the spring. He and his brother are taking turns to visit her on weekends. He seemed tired but okay.
Zoe's birthday is 19 January. She's been dropping hints about a pasta machine. She loves making fresh pasta and has done a class.

spans.text: dropping hints about a pasta machine

text: Karan and his wife are hosting Diwali dinner on 8 November 2026. His wife is the one who cooks, and Karan said she's making far too much food as always. I'm bringing dessert, something nut free.

Spent the morning with Uncle Thomas. He's started cooking for himself since Auntie passed away, mostly soups. He's quite proud of his leek and potato. He's still struggling on Sundays, which was always their day for a roast. His neighbour has started dropping round, which helps. I want to have him over for lunch one Sunday in November, and I should ask whether he still can't eat onions.

spans.text: quite proud of his leek and potato
ask whether he still can't eat onions

text: Simone's partner Jasmine got made redundant last week. Simone says she's taking it badly and spending all day on job sites. I need to send Simone a message to see how they're both doing.
Phoebe told me Nikhil has a shellfish allergy. Found out the hard way at her birthday dinner last year.
Rebecca kept her job! She heard this afternoon. Her manager Haruto wasn't so lucky though; he's leaving at the end of the month. I should congratulate Rebecca and maybe drop Haruto a message too.

Elena's mum passed away on 3 October 2026 after a long illness. Elena has gone back to Spain for a few weeks to help her dad sort things out. She said they're both okay but it's a lot. She's back sometime around mid November. I'd like to get something for when she's back, maybe her favourite Turkish delight, and make sure the team doesn't overwhelm her on her first day. Remind me to ask Kemal when exactly she lands.

spans.text: make sure the team doesn't overwhelm her
ask Kemal when exactly she lands

text: Aarav's dad loves Indian sweets, especially jalebi. Gift idea for when they visit.
Long chat with Matilda's mum, Angela, at pickup. Matilda is struggling since her best friend moved away over the summer. Angela is thinking of signing her up to swimming to help her make new friends.

The Popescus' anniversary dinner was called off because Bogdan's mum had a fall. She's in hospital with a broken wrist, but they think she'll be home by the end of the week. Zara said they'll rebook the restaurant for sometime in early December instead. Bogdan is driving up to see his mum on Saturday and staying until Tuesday. Remind me to ask him how she's doing when he's back.

spans.text: by the end of the week

text: Thabo gets migraines from red wine, so he only drinks white or beer. He mentioned it when I offered him a Malbec.
Groceries: oat milk, gluten free pasta, lemons, coriander, bin bags.

spans.text: oat milk, gluten free pasta, lemons, coriander, bin bags

text: Jin's dog Rolo had an operation on his leg on Monday. Jin is taking him back to the vet on 30 October 2026 to get the stitches out. Rolo is apparently sulking in the cone.

spans.text: taking him back to the vet

text: Coffee with Zara. Her ex, Milan, has moved in with someone new, only three months after they split up. She's trying not to care but obviously does. Her sister told her to delete his number. She said she's going to take a break from dating until the new year.
Felix said his mum makes the best pierogi. He's going home to Kraków over Christmas and she'll be making them for Wigilia.

Sinead mentioned that her dad, Graham, is retiring in March 2027 after thirty years at the fire service. They're planning a big party but haven't set the date. Must remember to get him something nice.

spans.text: thirty years at the fire service

text: Aiko and her boyfriend Louis are vegetarian, but they both eat fish occasionally. He's the fussier one; no olives, no capers.
Quiet day. Finished the book I was reading and did a big batch cook for the week. Nothing much to note.
Bogdan said his brother lost his job at the warehouse at the end of September. Bogdan has been helping him with his CV. He asked if I knew anyone hiring in logistics, so I should ask around at work.

spans.text: lost his job at the warehouse

text: Divya's grandmother turns ninety on 15 February 2027. The whole family is going to a restaurant in Leicester. Divya says she's a fussy eater and only really likes plain food, so finding a place has been a nightmare. Her cousin wanted somewhere fancy, but her aunt vetoed it. They've settled on a small Gujarati place that her grandmother has been going to since the seventies.
Tamar's mum died two years ago this week. She mentioned it quietly at lunch. Remind me to check in on her on Friday, which is the actual anniversary.
Nikhil, or Nik as everyone calls him, is moving to Manchester at the end of the year for a new job. His girlfriend is staying in London for now, and they're going to try long distance.
I'm doing the cooking for Mum's birthday on Saturday. Need to remember that Auntie Mei can't have dairy and Uncle Haruto is off sugar.

Jasmine found out yesterday that she got the job at the hospital. She starts sometime early in the new year. She's over the moon after such a rough few months. Remind me to send her a congratulations message tonight.

spans.text: got the job at the hospital
sometime early in the new year

text: Duc's wife, Elena, is doing Dry January again in 2027, and she's roped him into it this time. He's not thrilled.

Rebecca said Zoe's ex has been messaging her again, which Zoe hasn't mentioned to me. Zoe's flat sale is supposed to complete at the end of the month, and then she moves in with Ebony until she finds somewhere. Ebony doesn't seem thrilled, because her own boyfriend has only just moved in. Rebecca thinks Zoe should talk to someone about the breakup. I shouldn't bring up the messages, but I could invite her round for dinner sometime next week.
Kemal's sister Aaliyah is getting married on 12 June 2027 in Istanbul. Kemal says the menu is a nightmare because half the guests are vegetarian and the groom's side are all big meat eaters.
Need to cancel the gym membership before it renews in early December, and look into a cheaper one closer to home.

spans.text: before it renews in early December
look into a cheaper one closer to home

text: Spoke to Thomas after his redundancy meeting this afternoon. They've offered him a package and he has until the end of next week to decide. He's leaning towards taking it and going freelance. His partner Louis is supportive but a bit nervous about money, especially with the wedding planned for over the summer. Thomas sounded calmer than I expected. I should ring him on Monday to see what he's decided.

spans.text: until the end of next week

text: Matilda Lewis from next door said her husband's memorial service is on 21 November 2026. She'd like people to bring a dish instead of flowers. I'm making my lentil soup, which she always liked.
Phoebe's favourite drink is a negroni, and she's obsessed with that little Sicilian deli on the high street. Good to know for her birthday in the spring.

spans.text: little Sicilian deli on the high street
